newsitem.title: UK: Hanson up as report raises disposal hopes.
newsitem.headline: Hanson up as report raises disposal hopes.

text.p: Shares in Hanson Plc rose on Monday after a report in the Mail on Sunday newspaper said the company was poised to sell non-core electrical activities in a move that could boost its share price, dealers said.
The stock was up 7p, or 2.5 percent, at 281 by 1215 GMT, making it one of the top performers in the market as a whole. Volume was modest at 469,130 shares.

The Mail report said Hanson was in advanced talks to sell its Marbo and Volex electrical products unit, a move that would be well received as demonstrating its change of culture from a acquisition-driven group.
No-one at Hanson was immediately available for comment.
Having spun off its tobacco, energy and chemical operations in recent months, former conglomerate Hanson is now focused on building materials.
